snippet.title: Whiskers In The Sand Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into the desert to shred through waves of undead and sand-born horrors. Whiskers In The Sand mixes survivors-like arena combat with roguelite buildcrafting — unlock new cats, gather relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds. Experiment, survive, and end the pharaoh's second reign.

Wishlist on STEAM! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4221330/Whiskers_In_The_Sand/
